meta.title: DIASPORALE — the network of Gabonese people abroad
meta.description: The closed social network of the Gabonese diaspora: your country, your community, and you always know who is posting.

footer.label: Information
footer.publisher: DIASPORALE is published by NTSAGUI Digital. The network is reserved for Gabonese people living abroad.

landing.title: The Gabonese diaspora, country by country.
landing.lead: A closed network, reserved for Gabonese people abroad. Every post carries its country, every author shows their trust level, and contact always goes through messaging.
landing.boardFooter: Your country isn't listed? Join anyway: you can read everything today, and your posts are reviewed by the network team before they appear.
landing.principleCountryBody: Every post carries its country, or the label “The whole diaspora”. Your feed starts with your country of residence.
landing.principleTrustBody: Official, Verified, Public servant or Community: the badge is computed by the platform, never declared by the author.
landing.principleContactBody: No email address or phone number on any page or listing: a “Write” button replaces them.
landing.howLead: Two doors, and never a password.
landing.doorIdnBody: You sign in with identite.ga, the Gabonese digital identity. Your account is declared from the start.
landing.doorIdnNote: With assurance level 2, you carry the Verified badge.
landing.doorCodeTitle: With a code sent by email or text
landing.doorCodeBody: A light account: you read your hub right away. You can post once a verified member sponsors you, or once your consular registration is verified.
landing.doorCodeNote: Your sponsor must have been verified for more than 30 days.
landing.step1: Your country and city of residence.
landing.step2: Your display name and your handle, which you choose.
landing.step3: Your consents, one by one, none ticked in advance.
landing.verifyNote: Registered with a consulate? You can ask to verify your consular registration: you consent, we receive a confirmation, and your account becomes Verified.
landing.closing: Your country of residence is already here. So is your community.

entry.title: Join DIASPORALE
entry.lead: Choose your door. You will never create a password.
entry.idnBody: Sign in with identite.ga. Your account is declared from the start; with assurance level 2, it carries the Verified badge.
entry.codeBody: Light account: you read right away, you post after a sponsorship or the verification of your consular registration.
entry.noPassword: No password: IDN or a one-time code. Your contact details are never shown to other members.

idn.title: Sign in with IDN
idn.lead: In production, this button takes you to identite.ga, then brings you back here.
idn.simulation: Demonstration: this screen simulates identite.ga's consent screen with fictitious identities. No data is sent.

preset.awa: Assurance level 2, Gabonese nationality, registered with a demonstration post.
preset.yannick: Assurance level 1, Gabonese nationality, expired consular registration.
preset.foreign: Assurance level 2, non-Gabonese nationality: the IDN door is not enough.

idn.customBody: Enter a first name, a last name and an assurance level.
idn.receives: Your IDN identifier, your assurance level, your nationality, and your first and last names to suggest a handle.
idn.never: Your identification number, your date and place of birth, your address.
idn.consent: I allow DIASPORALE to receive this information.

code.title: Get a code
code.lead: A one-time code, valid for 10 minutes. It works only once.
code.destinationHint: It stays private: no member can see it.

welcome.step1Lead: Your country of residence frames everything you will see. You can change it later.
welcome.step2Lead: Your display name and handle are the same in DIASPORALE and in ANTIA.
welcome.step3Lead: Each consent is separate and can be withdrawn at any time in your settings.
welcome.countryHint: Gabon is not offered: DIASPORALE is the network of Gabonese people abroad.
welcome.countrySheetDescription: Search by name or by code.
welcome.countryNotOpen: This country isn't open yet: you can read everything, and your local posts are reviewed by the network team.
welcome.cityHint: Optional. By default, only your connections see it.
welcome.displayNameHint: The name members will see. It is never copied from an official document.
welcome.handleHint: It identifies you on the network (@handle). No suggestion is chosen for you.
welcome.handleRules: 3 to 30 characters: unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
welcome.consentsFooter: You can withdraw each consent in one step from your settings.

socialProfile.title: Create my social profile
socialProfile.body: Your display name, handle and country are visible to DIASPORALE members. Without this consent, there is no membership.

directory.title: Appear in the member directory
directory.body: Hidden by default. If you accept, you choose who can find you. People contact you only through messaging.
directory.levelLabel: Who can find you in the directory
directory.country: Members in my country of residence

notifications.title: Receive notifications
notifications.body: Replies to your posts and life in your country. Never the content of a message inside the notification.

social_profile.title: Social profile
social_profile.body: Required to be a member. Withdrawing it means leaving DIASPORALE.

directory.title: Member directory
directory.body: Appear in the directory, at the level you choose.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Replies, mentions, life in your country.

consular_attestation.title: Consular attestation
consular_attestation.body: Given at the time of verification. Withdrawing it prevents any new request.

talents.title: Visible professional profile
talents.body: Coming soon: the talent directory arrives with jobs.

status.pendingBody: You can read your hub and pages. To post, ask a verified member to sponsor you, or verify your consular registration.
status.declaredBody: You can post. To get the Verified badge: activate your IDN digital identity or verify your consular registration.
status.declaredVerifiedBody: You carry the Verified badge. Verifying your consular registration will complete your account.
status.suspendedUntil: Until {{date}}. You can appeal to the moderation team.
status.suspendedIndefinite: Until the moderation team decides. You can appeal.

badge.officialHint: Page of a recognized institution (consular post, ministry).
badge.verifiedHint: Level 2 digital identity, attested consular registration, or validated claim.
badge.publicAgentHint: Government employee linked to their administration account.
badge.communityHint: Community member or page, not verified.

moderation.pendingHint: Only you can see it until the moderation team decides.

demo.bannerBody: All data is fictitious and stays in this browser.
demo.title: Demonstration
demo.lead: The social engine isn't connected yet: this version runs on a demonstration provider. People, associations and posts are fictitious; nothing leaves this browser.

r1.title: R1 — A registered person joins with IDN
r1.step1: Sign in, then “IDN digital identity”; choose Awa Ogooué and allow.
r1.step3: Pick a suggested handle, then tick the social profile.
r1.step4: Check: declared account, France hub, derived ANTIA membership in settings.

r2.title: R2 — Verify a consular registration
r2.step1: After R1, open “Verify my consular registration”.
r2.step2: Read what is asked, received and never received; tick the consent.
r2.step4: Check: verified account, Verified badge, consular post.

r3.title: R3 — A light account gets sponsored
r3.step1: Sign in with a code, choose “Canada” and “Montréal”.
r3.step3: Here, switch to Mireille (verified for more than 30 days) and sponsor your handle.
r3.step4: Switch back to your account: it is declared and can post (content reviewed, Canada not being open).

demo.accountsBody: Switch accounts to play several roles. This switcher only exists in the demonstration.

accounts.mireille: Verified by consular attestation for more than 30 days: she can sponsor.
accounts.prisca: Verified by IDN level 2 and sponsorship.
accounts.steeve: Declared by IDN level 1, in Lyon.

demo.resetBody: Erases your demonstration accounts, posts and choices, and reloads the fictitious data set.
demo.charteLink: See the design charter and every component

scopeHint.mon_pays: {{country}}, and what concerns the whole diaspora.
scopeHint.diaspora: What concerns the whole diaspora, whatever the country.
scopeHint.recents: Everything you can read, newest first.
scopeHint.pour_vous: Your connections, and the pages and groups you follow.

mon_pays.title: Nothing yet in {{country}}.
mon_pays.body: The first posts bring a hub to life. Go ahead.

diaspora.title: No post for the whole diaspora yet.
diaspora.body: Choose “The whole diaspora” when posting to reach every country.

pour_vous.title: Your “For you” feed is empty.
pour_vous.body: Connect with members and follow pages to fill it.

composer.notAllowed: Posting is possible after a sponsorship or a verification
composer.title: New post
composer.description: Write, choose where and for whom, then post.
composer.reviewNotice: Your country isn't open yet: the post will be reviewed before it appears.
composer.alsoOnRootHint: It will also be read in ANTIA, the public network, and will stay in DIASPORALE.
composer.alsoOnRootDisabled: Only possible for a post readable by all members.
composer.sentForReview: Sent for review: you will be told about the decision.

post.reactDisabled: Reacting is possible after a sponsorship or a verification.

page.claimSoon: Claiming with supporting documents arrives with the association import.
page.officialNote: Official page: only the post's authorized staff can publish here.
page.noPosts: This page hasn't posted anything yet.
page.unavailableBody: It doesn't exist, or you can't see it.

contact.soon: Messaging is coming soon: no contact will ever go through a displayed address or number.

hub.title: The community — {{country}}
hub.notOpenNotice: {{country}} isn't open yet. You can read everything; local posts are reviewed by the network team. A country opens with two relay associations and one moderator.
hub.switchDescription: You can read the hub of any country.
hub.countersDemo: Demonstration counters, computed on the fictitious data.
hub.welcomeBody: You are also a member of ANTIA, the public network, with the same profile. What you post here stays in DIASPORALE, unless you tick “Also post on ANTIA”.
hub.emptyPostsBody: Practical information, a question, a good tip: the first post launches the hub.
hub.emptyEventsBody: Events from associations and consular posts will appear here.
hub.emptyAssociationsBody: Community associations arrive with the public import, then claim their pages.
hub.emptyCompaniesBody: Diaspora businesses will be able to create their page.
hub.dormantBody: Nobody has posted here yet. You can be one of the first.
hub.notFoundBody: Hubs cover the diaspora's countries of residence.

profile.previewNotice: Preview: what a member from another country, not connected to you, sees.
profile.unavailableBody: It doesn't exist, or you can't see it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.membershipsLead: Joining DIASPORALE also made you a member of ANTIA. Your contexts stay separate.
settings.rootDerived: Membership derived from DIASPORALE: same profile, same handle. Leaving DIASPORALE doesn't remove you from ANTIA.
settings.attestationNotConfirmed: We could not confirm your consular registration.
settings.facetLead: What the community knows about you, and who can see it, field by field.
settings.directoryLead: Hidden by default. People contact you only through messaging, never through an address.
settings.directoryNeedsConsent: First turn on the “Member directory” consent below.

directoryLevel.country: Visible to members in my country

settings.consentsLead: Each choice is time-stamped and can be withdrawn in one step.
settings.leaveExplain: Leaving DIASPORALE withdraws your social profile consent. Your ANTIA membership remains.
settings.leaveConfirmBody: Your profile will no longer be visible in DIASPORALE. You can come back; a new sponsorship may be needed.
settings.sponsorHelpLead: A member verified for more than 30 days can sponsor a pending account using its handle.
settings.sponsorHelpPending: To post: ask a member verified for more than 30 days to sponsor you. All they need is your handle.
settings.dataLead: Download everything DIASPORALE knows about you, or erase your account.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Your profile, posts, reactions, consents and sponsorships will be erased. Content that mentioned you will show “deleted account”.
settings.deleteAcknowledge: I understand that erasure is permanent.
settings.sessionLead: Signs out this device and all others.

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.lead: You admit into DIASPORALE a pending account you know. Every sponsorship is logged; you can withdraw it.
sponsor.tooRecent: You can sponsor from {{date}}: you need to have been verified for more than 30 days.
sponsor.quota: {{remaining}} sponsorships left out of {{total}} (over the last {{days}} days)
sponsor.handleLabel: Handle of the account to sponsor
sponsor.handleHint: The person gives it to you: it starts with @.
sponsor.noneGivenBody: Sponsor someone close who gave you their handle.

attestation.title: Verify my consular registration
attestation.lead: Registered with a consular post? With your consent, DIASPORALE asks consulat.ga for a confirmation, and nothing else.
attestation.asked: Whether an active consular registration exists for your digital identity or your verified address.
attestation.received: Yes or no, the country, the consular post and the registration date.
attestation.never: Your passport, your identification number, your civil status, your children, your file.
attestation.consent: I agree that DIASPORALE asks consulat.ga for this confirmation.
attestation.success: Consular registration confirmed: your account is verified.
attestation.notConfirmedTitle: We could not confirm your registration.
attestation.notConfirmedBody: You remain a member. You can try again in 24 hours, or register with the consulate.
attestation.footer: One request per 24 hours. Your consent is recorded before the request.

section1.title: Publisher
section1.body: DIASPORALE is published by NTSAGUI Digital. The publisher's full details will be published after legal validation.

section2.title: Publication director
section2.body: To be appointed by the publisher.

section3.title: Hosting
section3.body: The hosting provider and region will be stated here once chosen and contracted.

section4.title: Intellectual property
section4.body: Content published by members remains theirs; they allow it to be shared in the network they choose.

section1.title: Data controller
section1.body: To be confirmed by the lawyer. Applicable law: Gabonese law no. 001/2011 as amended by law no. 025/2023 (APDPVP); the GDPR for residents of the European Union.

section2.title: What we process
section2.body: Your profile (display name, handle, country of residence), your content and your consents. No consular data: a consular attestation is limited to a yes or no, a country, a post and a date.

section3.title: Your choices
section3.body: Each consent is separate, time-stamped and can be withdrawn in your settings. The directory is hidden by default.

section4.title: Your rights
section4.body: You download your data and erase your account from your settings. The competent authority in Gabon is the APDPVP.

charte.title: “Diaspora sand” charter
charte.lead: DIASPORALE's components mounted with fictitious sample data, for review and acceptance testing in both themes.
charte.stripeNote: The tricolour line: the only use of the flag colours, decorative.
charte.typeBody: IBM Plex Sans carries body text and the interface, at 15 pixels for people reading on phones.

sample.description: A fictitious sample description, two lines at most.
sample.postBody: Sample post for the whole diaspora, from another country: the origin label says so.
sample.classifiedTitle: Space in a suitcase to Libreville
sample.emptyBody: Suggest the first one: it will be reviewed, then published.
sample.advertiserMessage: A labelled slot, never more than one per screen, never in messaging.
